authority_refs.section: §§6.10–6.11 and applicable Identity, Privacy and Temperament ownership
Tests, review and proof (applicable HIGH guidance)

records.outcome: In the synthetic scope, accept only approved offer versions with unambiguous terms, valid current disclosure evidence and complete, deterministic allocation in currency minor units. Component amounts must sum to the accepted total. Preserve the immutable accepted snapshot. Under DEC-328, development amounts, savings and component splits are synthetic fixtures. Real sales require approved launch configuration from authorised Commerce operators and disclosure of the applicable allocation before checkout.
records.actor_journey: Authorised payer and scoped recipient at the Commerce and Entitlements boundary.
records.lifecycle: Accept the current guarded offer version and preserve its immutable snapshot.
records.invariant: The allocation sums exactly in minor units. Historical obligations and refunds use the original snapshot.
records.acceptance_adversarial_and_proof: Use S1-01–05 and applicable concurrency and replay checks. Cover at least two valid synthetic offer versions with different valid allocations, repricing after acceptance, rejection of stale quotes and stale or mismatched disclosure evidence, a one-minor-unit mismatch and a historical refund based on the original accepted allocation. Apply the relevant HIGH proof guidance when the underlying work calls for it.
records.exclusions: Synthetic development and proof require no launch-price approval. Final split selection, actual launch pricing and real sale approval are outside this reference.
records.proof_status: Scoped proof guidance only. Use the linked ticket and implementation evidence to verify actual results.
records.ticket_context: Integrated historical implementation context. Apply this reference prospectively without reopening the original work.

authority_refs.section: §§6.10–6.11 and applicable Identity, Privacy and Temperament ownership
Tests, review and proof (applicable HIGH guidance)

records.outcome: Active available_unused or held_unconsumed ordinary credit blocks a new Assessment or bundle. Plan-only admission remains independent and must satisfy its own guards. Missing, stale or contradictory required owner history fails affected admission closed. Commerce fences competing potentially collectible attempts and outstanding paid consequences.
records.actor_journey: Authorised payer and scoped recipient at the Commerce and Entitlements boundary.
records.lifecycle: Read credit and delivery history from their owners. Reject affected admission when required evidence is unavailable and preserve existing credit.
records.invariant: Entitlements owns credit and Temperament owns delivery history. Commerce distinguishes verified absence from unavailable evidence.
records.acceptance_adversarial_and_proof: Use S1-07–14 and applicable race proof with owner-approved synthetic credit and delivery-history facts. Exercise competing collectible attempts, outstanding paid consequences and the independent Plan-only path.
records.exclusions: Exact annual calendar arithmetic, suspended-credit disposition, downstream Assessment implementation, real payment and pilot admission are outside this reference.
records.proof_status: Scoped proof guidance only. Use the linked ticket and implementation evidence to verify actual results.
